posts.author: m-lena
posts.text: Week 3 of the Web Dev Bootcamp done ✅ Today we finally connected our React front end to the API we built last week. Seeing data flow end to end felt amazing!
comments: Same feeling here! The async/await lesson finally clicked for me.
Wait until you deploy it — that's the real magic moment 🚀

posts.author: m-marco
posts.text: First green wave this morning 🌊 Coach said my pop-up is finally fast enough. Ericeira, you have my heart.
comments: Congrats!! Which break were you at?
Foz do Lizandro — perfect for beginners at low tide.
Goals 😍 booking the surf camp for spring

posts.author: m-aisha
posts.text: Our capstone team is predicting bike-share demand across the city with weather + event data. Any tips for feature engineering on time series?
comments: Lag features and rolling means are your friends. Also holidays!

posts.author: m-tom
posts.text: Tip for anyone arriving in Berlin: register your address (Anmeldung) in your first week. Book the appointment online before you fly — slots go fast.
comments: This is gold. Wish I'd known on day one.

posts.author: m-sofia
posts.text: UX/UI Sprint, day 4: five user interviews done. Funny how the problem we thought we were solving isn't the one users actually have 😅
comments: That's exactly why research comes first!
People don't want more features — they want fewer steps.

posts.author: m-kenji
posts.text: Shipped my first React Native app to a real phone today 📱 It's a tiny tool to log tennis matches with friends. Next: offline sync.
comments: Nice! Use it at Baseline and send me the link 😄

posts.author: m-nora
posts.text: Yoga Teacher Training week 2: I taught my first 20-minute flow to the group. Nervous at first, then it just flowed. Lisbon sunsets after class are unreal.
comments: Lisbon sunsets are the best reward ☀️

posts.author: m-lucas
posts.text: Friendly match at the academy today — we lost 3–2 but I scored my first goal ⚽ The coaches' feedback on positioning has been a game changer.
comments: Video session tomorrow will be fun 😂

posts.author: m-mia
posts.text: Best cheap lunch near the Pixel & Flow studio? I've done pastéis de nata three days in a row and I regret nothing.
comments: Try the bifana place on Rua do Alecrim!

posts.author: m-daniel
posts.text: Capture-the-flag finale at SecureNet tonight. 14 flags in 4 hours. Our team got 11 and the SQL injection one almost broke me.

posts.author: m-yara
posts.text: Day 3 of the Ski Camp: linked my first parallel turns on a red run 🎿 The instructors here are so patient.

posts.author: m-oliver
posts.text: Tennis Camp check-in: my serve toss is finally consistent. Six people per coach means you get real feedback every rally.

posts.author: m-lena
posts.text: Free JavaScript meetup in Kreuzberg this Thursday — three short talks plus pizza. Who from CodeForge is joining?
comments: I'll be in Berlin that week, saving it!

posts.author: m-marco
posts.text: Soft-top vs hard board for week two? Coach recommends staying on the foamie until I'm catching waves consistently.
comments: Listen to the coach 😄 foamies are fun!

posts.author: m-aisha
posts.text: Sunday canal cycle with the DataLab crew 🚲 Best way to reset after a week of gradient descent.
comments: Amsterdam on a sunny Sunday hits different

posts.author: m-sofia
posts.text: Portfolio review day: mentors suggested I show my messy sketches, not only the polished screens. Hiring managers want to see the process.

posts.author: m-kenji
posts.text: Coding in the morning, beach volleyball in the evening. Valencia might be the best place to learn mobile dev 😎

posts.author: m-nora
posts.text: Lisbon transport tip: get a Navegante card on day one. One tap for metro, tram and ferry — and the 28 tram is better before 9 am.

posts.author: m-tom
posts.text: Had my first technical interview — they asked me to explain a project from the bootcamp. Demo day practice really paid off.

posts.author: m-lucas
posts.text: Proper paella in Valencia after training — the residence chef says the secret is the socarrat (the crispy bottom). I'm a believer.
comments: Paella Sunday is a must here

posts.author: m-mia
posts.text: Design systems lesson today. Building components with auto layout in Figma is weirdly satisfying.
comments: Wait until you get to variants!

posts.author: m-daniel
posts.text: Security BSides talk recordings are up — the one on phishing simulations is a great intro if you're starting the Fundamentals course.

posts.author: m-yara
posts.text: Took the funicular up to the Nordkette on our rest day. 2,000 m above the city in twenty minutes — the views are absurd.

posts.author: m-oliver
posts.text: Beachside Sports Residence review: recovery pool + sports menu = exactly what you need after two training sessions a day.
comments: Can confirm, the pool is elite

posts.author: m-lena
posts.text: Berlin döner ranking after three weeks of research (purely academic, of course). DM me for the full spreadsheet 😂

posts.author: m-marco
posts.text: Surf, sleep, eat, repeat. Week one of Surf Camp flew by. Staying another week — couldn't leave yet.

posts.author: m-aisha
posts.text: Our partner company offered internships to two people from the cohort after capstone presentations! 🎉

posts.author: m-kenji
posts.text: Tip for mobile devs: test on a low-end Android phone early. My smooth animations on iPhone were a slideshow on an old device.

posts.author: m-sofia
posts.text: Weekend trip from Barcelona to Montserrat with the design cohort. Sketchbooks out on the train 🚆

posts.author: m-nora
posts.text: Community yoga on the riverfront this Saturday at 9 am — all levels, bring a mat if you have one.
comments: Wish I could join from the Alps!
